questions.prompt: Which continent is East Timor in?

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find East Timor on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find East Timor on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of East Timor?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the East Timor article.

questions.proof: It is a member of the United Nations, the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and the Community of Portuguese Language Countries.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of East Timor?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the East Timor article.

questions.proof: The capital and largest city, Dili, is home to one hundred and fifty thousand people.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: East Timor about 14,919 square kilometres; Singapore about 719 square kilometres; Federated States of Micronesia about 702 square kilometres; Palau about 466 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Dili?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of East Timor is Dili.
